summary: Verdict: ADVERSE (33% confidence) based on the SEC civil lawsuit filed on 2023-09-18 alleging fraud by NDB Inc. and its CEO Nima Golsharifi; no evidence of criminal conviction, personal liability, bankruptcy, or leadership changes as of 2026-09-30.
